posted_text:
🏥 Healthcare
NJ A4309 — NJ Nursing Home Licenses Get New Rules

New Jersey is updating how nursing home administrators get licensed. The board will now issue licenses within 90 days of an application. They’ll also review intern training programs within 15 days, approving or rejecting them. Administrators must notify the board within six months of address or name changes, providing supporting documentation. ...
